name: Record and resolve project risks
short_description: Record and resolve project risks once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can record and resolve project risks in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Record and resolve project risks means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
